nodes.description: address private creator; privileged address gate-checked throughout _transfer/_approve
bool private waterpipe; one-shot flag that toggles creator-sender special path in _transfer
mapping(address=>bool) poseidon; privileged/whitelist flag that bypasses transfer restrictions
mapping(address=>bool) kraken; flag used to force allowance value 78764 in _approve
mapping(address=>bool) shitting; flag used to hard-revert (require(false)) transfers
uint256 private papers; owner-settable transfer limit enforced as require(amount < papers)
uint256 private onthefloora; threshold compared against amount in _transfer
uint256 private chTx; base unit derived in constructor and reset in _transfer
bool private teeth; global switch that enables one-shot shitting flag application in _transfer
bool private seats; one-shot flag that triggers creator privilege grant in _approve
uint shark; monotonically increasing entropy counter used by randomly()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances; token balances mutated in _transfer/_mint/_burn
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances; allowance storage written in _approve
uint256 private _totalSupply; minted/burned supply counter
constructor(): sets creator, privileges, supply, chTx/onthefloora and initial balances
_transfer(address,address,uint256): internal transfer with creator/poseidon/kraken/shitting/teeth gating and require(false) traps
_approve(address,address,uint256): internal approval that grants privileges and can override amount with kraken-based 78764
_mint(address,uint256): internal supply inflation used by owner-only CreateAFarm
_burn(address,uint256): internal supply reduction
_burnFrom(address,uint256): burn using allowance path
randomly(): internal pseudo-random generator built from now/msg.sender/shark, mutates shark
transfer(address,uint256): external ERC20 entrypoint delegating to _transfer with _msgSender()
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): external entrypoint calling _transfer and _approve with allowance subtraction
approve(address,uint256): external ERC20 approval delegating to _approve
increasealowance(address,uint256): increases allowance via _approve
decreaseallowance(address,uint256): decreases allowance via _approve
CreateAFarm(uint256): onlyOwner mint to _msgSender()
CheckAPY(address,bool,bool,bool,bool): onlyOwner mass privilege/flag setter (poseidon/kraken/shitting/teeth)
SetStakingReward(uint256): onlyOwner setter of papers transfer limit
BringFreedom(): onlyOwner function that recomputes papers and enables teeth
onlyOwner modifier: require(_msgSender()==_owner || _msgSender()==_ownr) access gate
msg.sender / _msgSender() external caller address, attacker controllable
block.timestamp (now) miner-influenceable entropy source used in randomly()
uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, shark))) % 50 in randomly(): timestamp-dependent pseudo-randomness
_balances[sender].sub(amount) and _balances[recipient].add(amount) writes at the tail of _transfer
require(false) hard-revert traps in _transfer driven by owner-controlled poseidon/shitting/teeth flags (transfer censorship/griefing)
_allowances[owner][spender] = tok where tok = kraken[owner] ? 78764 : amount: silent allowance override plus one-shot privilege grant
uint256 amount parameter of SetStakingReward
uint256 amount parameter of CreateAFarm
address spender parameter of CheckAPY holding the flag target
bool val parameter of CheckAPY setting poseidon[spender]
address sender parameter of _transfer
address recipient parameter of _transfer
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer compared with papers/onthefloora
address owner parameter of _approve
address spender parameter of _approve
uint256 amount parameter of _approve
local uint screen in randomly() holding the pseudo-random result
local uint256 tok in _approve holding the final allowance value written to storage

edges.reason: constructor reads msg.sender to set creator and grant poseidon privileges
creator is assigned from external msg.sender at deployment
constructor initializes _balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor assigns _totalSupply = 5000000000000000
block.timestamp (now) is used as the randomness seed (timestamp dependency)
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness hash in randomly()
shark counter feeds the pseudo-random hash and is incremented
randomly() executes the weak timestamp/msg.sender randomness operation
shark++ mutates the entropy counter after the random draw
_transfer uses randomly() result to decide kraken[recipient], so transfer outcome depends on miner-manipulable entropy
_transfer performs the balance subtraction/addition state updates
_transfer reaches the require(false) traps driven by owner-set poseidon/shitting/teeth flags
_transfer branches on address(sender) == creator to change papers/teeth/waterpipe
_transfer reads waterpipe to grant poseidon[recipient] on the creator's first transfer
poseidon[sender]/poseidon[recipient] short-circuit the transfer checks and bypass restrictions
kraken[sender] propagates kraken[recipient] = true
shitting[sender] gates the require(false) revert path
papers is enforced via require(amount < papers) and rewritten when sender == creator
onthefloora is compared against amount to set shitting[recipient]
teeth enables the one-shot shitting[sender] = true poisoning path
_approve branches on seats to grant poseidon/kraken/shitting privileges to spender
_allowances[owner][spender] is written by _approve
kraken[owner] forces tok = 78764 instead of the requested amount
_approve executes the silent allowance override and privilege grant
transfer() delegates to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer(sender, recipient, amount)
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce allowance with .sub(amount)
approve() delegates to _approve
increasealowance() delegates to _approve with .add(addedValue)
decreaseallowance() delegates to _approve with .sub(subtractedValue)
CreateAFarm() mints via _mint(_msgSender(), amount)
CreateAFarm mints to _msgSender(), so the caller receives newly created supply
CheckAPY writes poseidon[spender] = val
CheckAPY writes kraken[spender] = val2
CheckAPY writes shitting[spender] = val3
CheckAPY writes the global teeth flag
onlyOwner evaluates _msgSender() against _owner/_ownr
onlyOwner guards SetStakingReward
onlyOwner guards BringFreedom
onlyOwner guards CreateAFarm (owner-only mint)
onlyOwner guards CheckAPY (owner-only privilege/flag control)
SetStakingReward assigns papers = amount, changing the transfer limit
BringFreedom resets papers = chTx / 2400, silently changing transfer limits
BringFreedom sets teeth = true, enabling the one-shot shitting poisoning in _transfer
amount parameter flows into papers in SetStakingReward
amount parameter flows into _mint in CreateAFarm
spender parameter selects the account whose flags are modified in CheckAPY
val parameter sets poseidon[spender] in CheckAPY
sender parameter drives the require and identifier checks in _transfer
recipient parameter receives poseidon/kraken/shitting flags in _transfer
amount parameter is compared with onthefloora and papers and subtracted from balances
owner parameter indexes _allowances and is checked against creator in _approve
spender parameter is the allowance target in _approve
amount parameter is the requested allowance in _approve
screen local holds the weak randomness result returned by randomly()
tok local holds the possibly overridden allowance value written in _approve
